facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; you may keep or freely sell foreign currency earned from foreign clients.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: you can keep service earnings in a foreign-currency bank account.
facts.P3_local_gateways: iyzico's pay-by-link needs no company; its virtual POS needs a sole proprietorship.
facts.L1_registration: Register with your tax office within 10 days, unless you qualify for the creator exemption.
facts.L2_tax_id: Your 11-digit T.C. kimlik (national ID) number is your tax ID.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 15–40%; creators and app developers pay a flat 15% withholding.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 20% KDV; services for customers abroad are exempt.
facts.L5_data_protection: KVKK (Law 6698); controllers under 50 staff needn't register in VERBIS.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers have 14 days to withdraw, except for instantly delivered digital goods.
facts.L7_incentives: 15% final tax for creators, 80% deduction on exported services, young-entrepreneur exemption.

watch_out.text: Selling from your own site or a foreign platform needs ETBİS registration first.
The 15% creator regime needs all income through a dedicated Turkish bank account.
The 80% export deduction needs the profit brought into Türkiye by the tax deadline.
